messages:
fiona: Posting — observed recurring aggregation drop after ETL lag overnight, similar to past postmortems. We need a short remediation plan and single owners.
omar: Details: late spans arriving after watermark, some have null trace_id due to parsing errors; ETL currently filters them out leading to lower counts.
sre-bot: incident_alert: aggregation_drop_detected at 2025-06-18T02:40:34Z lag=17m
leo: Immediate mitigation: route malformed spans to a 'spillover' topic instead of dropping. I'll open a feature-flagged hotfix.
maya: I'll run a targeted reconciliation sampler and post top keys. SQL I'm running: ```sql
SELECT metric_key, window_start, sum(raw_count) as raw, sum(coalesce(agg_count,0)) as agg, (sum(raw_count)-sum(coalesce(agg_count,0))) as delta
FROM reconciliation_view
WHERE ingestion_time >= now() - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY metric_key, window_start
HAVING abs(sum(raw_count)-sum(coalesce(agg_count,0))) > 5
ORDER BY abs(delta) DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
fiona: Owners suggestion: leo=hotfix+merge (0-2h), maya=sample+backfill plan (2-8h), omar=permanent fix+CI (24-72h), fiona=postmortem owner+product comms.
omar: Permanent fix: add overflow bucket + make aggregator tolerant to missing groups (guard divide-by-zero). Also add CI synthetic that injects late/malformed spans.
leo: Hotfix PR opened (#512). Will feature-flag and canary for 30m, ETA deploy to staging 30m.
maya: Sampler posted in #eng-data: top 12 keys affected, most under 1% except 2 keys ~3%. I'll prioritize backfill for those two.
sre-bot: deploy_event: hotfix-pr/512 merged to staging at 2025-06-18T03:10:12Z
leo: Canaries look clean, planning prod promote in 15m. Notifying analytics about cardinality bump with sample.
maya: Backfill plan: idempotent upserts into aggregator_canonical for prioritized windows, tag reconciled_by='remediation-3067891234'. I'll run a staging smoke before prod.
fiona: I'll update the postmortem doc with owners, due dates, and closing criteria: 4 weeks of clean reconciliation runs. Check-in in 6h. :white_check_mark:
